notes.title: Patch notes 12/1/16
notes.content:
-Fixed occasional freezes and delays happening during gameplay
-Fixed incorrect button mapping on XInput controllers
-PS buttons will now only be displayed when using DualShock4 controllers
-Fixed display glitches that were occurring on non-16:9 resolutions
-Fixed an issue where certain players would only see a green screen during the opening movie 
-Fixed crashes occurring on touch screen devices
